hero.title: Platz Care & Hospital Beds
hero.description: Reduce risk of aspiration and bedsores with our patented High Back Support Function. Very low-to-the-floor design (15 cm) prevents fall injuries. JIS-certified, made in Japan.

features.title: Why Platz Beds
features.subtitle: Patented Japanese engineering that reduces aspiration risk, alleviates bedsores, and prevents fall injuries — for hospitals, care facilities, and home care.

items.title: High Back Support Function
items.description: Patent-pending mechanism separates head/middle back from low back so each section's angle can be adjusted independently. Reduces sacrum pressure by up to 39% compared to conventional beds.

items.title: Reduced Risk of Aspiration
items.description: Adjusting the neck angle and reducing abdominal pressure when lifting the back helps with swallowing — supporting dysphagia rehabilitation and lowering the risk of aspiration pneumonia.

items.title: Very Low-to-the-Floor (15 cm)
items.description: The Rafio and Miolet III Basic Bed Series sit only 15 cm off the floor — ideal for users with cognitive impairments or anyone at risk of falling out of bed.

items.title: LINAK Motors from Denmark
items.description: Highly-functional, quiet motors with IPX4 water resistance (IPX6 for High Back models). 2-motor, 3-motor, and electric High Back configurations available.

items.title: Universal Design Control Switch
items.description: Color-coded carved buttons distinguishable by touch even for users with weak grip or low vision. Control lock function prevents accidental operation.

items.title: JIS T9254 Certified
items.description: All Platz beds meet Japan Industrial Standard T9254 for nursing care beds. Patent No. 5089786 (control switch shape) and patent-pending High Back Support Function and Reclining Control.

scenarios.title: Where Platz Beds Are Used
scenarios.subtitle: Trusted in hospitals, care facilities, and home environments across Japan and beyond. Each series is designed for a specific care setting.

items.name: Acute Care Hospitals
items.description: P300 Series hospital beds with CPR function, IV pole holders, urine bag hooks, and angle meter for clinical bedside care.

items.name: Long-Term Nursing Care
items.description: Rafio nursing care beds with patented High Back Support and very low-to-the-floor design for at-home or institutional long-term care.

items.name: Care Facilities
items.description: Ardel care facility beds combine the High Back Support Function with electric reclining for advanced care environments handling diverse physical conditions.

items.name: Home Care
items.description: Miolet III with vertical lifting installs in tight spaces, while Rafio Basic Bed at 15 cm height supports cognitively impaired family members safely at home.

items.name: Dysphagia & Rehabilitation
items.description: High Back Support Function adjusts neck angle and reduces abdominal pressure when lifting the back — supporting swallowing rehabilitation and reducing aspiration risk.

items.name: Bedsore Treatment
items.description: Reduces sacrum pressure by 31–39% compared to conventional back-raising mechanisms — supporting positioning therapy for users at risk of pressure ulcers.

cases.title: Clinical Evidence
cases.subtitle: Tested at Japanese hospitals using FSA (VERG Inc., Canada) pressure measurement equipment with Thank U Point and Amical Support mattresses.

items.title: Sacrum Pressure Reduced by 34% (30° Back Raising)
items.description: On the Rafio Series, conventional 30° back raising produces 53 mmHg of sacrum pressure. With the High Back Support Function, that drops to 35 mmHg — a 34% reduction.

items.title: Sacrum Pressure Reduced by 39% (70° Back Raising)
items.description: At a steeper 70° back raise, conventional beds reach 123 mmHg at the sacrum. With High Back Support, pressure drops to 75 mmHg — a 39% reduction.

items.title: P300 Hospital Bed: 31% Reduction at 60°
items.description: The P300 Series hospital bed reduces sacrum pressure by 31% when raising the back to 60°, from 97 mmHg to 67 mmHg compared to conventional back lifting.

items.title: Ardel Care Facility Bed: 28% Reduction at 70°
items.description: The Ardel Positioning Bed reduces maximum pressure from 118 mmHg to 85 mmHg at 70° back raising — a 28% improvement over conventional beds.

items.title: Improved Respiration & Posture
items.description: Spreading the diaphragm and reducing back pressure helps respiration. Curving the upper trunk also reduces force on circulatory organs, supporting users with kyphosis or pregnancy.

gallery.title: Board Options
gallery.subtitle: Three board styles to match any care environment — Resin, Wooden, and Wooden Shelf.

views.label: Resin Board
views.description: Lightweight, easy-to-clean resin headboard and footboard. Standard on Rafio, Miolet III, and Ardel series.

views.label: Wooden Board
views.description: Warm natural wood finish for home and care facility settings. Available in Natural Brown and Dark Brown.

views.label: Wooden Shelf Board
views.description: Wooden board with integrated shelf — convenient storage for personal items and devices at the head of the bed.

products.title: Product Lineup
products.subtitle: From low-floor nursing care beds for home environments to electric hospital beds for acute care — Platz offers a complete range of medical beds and accessories.

platform.title: Convenient Functions
platform.subtitle: Every Platz bed includes thoughtful features designed to reduce the burden on caregivers and improve quality of life for users.
platform.dashboardCaption: Universal Design Control Switch — color-coded carved buttons, easy to operate with a weak grip, distinguishable by touch.
platform.archCaption: Back / Knee Interlocking Motion reduces abdominal pressure and shear force with the press of a button.

modules.name: Swollen Reduction Foot Lift
modules.description: Foot-lifting function reduces leg swelling and improves circulation for bed-bound users.

modules.name: Vertical Lifting Function
modules.description: Lifts straight up rather than scissor-style — installs in tight bedrooms and small spaces.

modules.name: Knee Position Adjuster
modules.description: Pin-adjustable knee position (23 cm or 28 cm) accommodates users under or over 175 cm tall, reducing slippage during reclining.

modules.name: Wheelchair Transfer Support
modules.description: Retractable side rail holders allow a wheelchair to be placed close to the bed, making transfer easy and safe.

modules.name: Control Lock & CPR
modules.description: Lock the control switch to prevent accidental operation. CPR function lowers the back bottom manually in emergencies (Hospital Bed).

modules.name: Chargeable Battery (PE06-BA19)
modules.description: Optional 1.7 kg battery powers the bed during outages or in locations without electricity.
